name: David's Spurge
desc: David's Spurge (Euphorbia davidii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euphorbia davidii, known as David's spurge or toothed spurge, is a species of flowering plant in the spurge family Euphorbiaceae. It is an annual herb growing up to 2 feet (0.61 metres) tall.
